# Vase

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Vase
- **Artist / Maker:** Fritz Heckert Glass Refinery and Glassworks Petersdorf, Silesia (now Poland), 1866-1923 Possibly designed by Otto Thamm German, 1860-c. 1905 Possibly decorated by Adolph Heyden German, 1838-1902
- **Date:** c. 1900
- **Style / Period:** Art Deco
- **Classification:** vase
- **Department:** Applied Arts of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 216318
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/216318
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/ebe50463-49dc-187e-6072-296c2432b571/full/400,/0/default.jpg
